correctness.rationale: Companion M=[[a,b],[1,0]], b unit, has a cyclic vector, so normalized recurrence period equals matrix order. Mod p order h lifts only to h or ph. With Δ mod p≠0 separable characteristic roots have unique h-torsion Teichmüller/Hensel lifts, giving exactly one stable coefficient pair per base. Δ=0 yields a Jordan block of order pt. For p>=5, lower-left entry of M^(pt)-I equals pt λ^(pt-1) mod p² and is nonzero, excluding all stable lifts. For p=3 the cubic expansion gives Δ≡6 mod9 and exactly three stable lifts per repeated-root base, total 10; otherwise totals (p-1)². Independent integer enumeration of every coefficient lift over p=3,5,7 found stable totals 10,16,36; not a proof for all odd p.
residual_risks: Complete result for first p-to-p² lift only.
